says: In today's CI, the checklist faults step byte-checks every checklist- plant case's file against the catalog commit, and that includes checklist-pid's next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts. Pull request 1593 changes that file away from 3ca406a62's bytes, so the next run of the step on the current catalog fails automatic_catalog_image on runtime.ts even while the fixture keeps its catalog bytes. The fixture finding names only the fixture as pinned.
proof: .github/ci/plant-related.ts:18-22 makes `keys` every case whose name starts with checklist-; .github/ci/plant-cases.ts:35-37 gives checklist-pid the file next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts; plant-related.ts:353-366 compares each key's file with `git show ${catalog}:${file}` and fails automatic_catalog_image on a difference, with checklist-pid first in the loop. `git diff --quiet 3ca406a62 fae483d0c -- next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts` exits 1, while `git diff --quiet 3ca406a62 origin/main -- next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts` exits 0.
cost: After 1593 merges, the next pull request that changes the fixture or a plant script fails the step on a file it never touched, unless https://github.com/kamp-us/tea-fabrika/pull/1569 (which deletes plant-related.ts and re-pins the cases) lands first, or runtime.ts is re-pinned.
